'''Stenness lizard pie''' was a foodstuff that was available for consumption in the [[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]]. While briefly visiting the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[A-3DO]] was sent to purchase food for his master, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Andur Sunrider]], and [[Sunrider family|his family]]. Threedee returned with refreshments, which Sunrider hoped did not include Stenness lizard pie, as he suspected that his daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]] would find it unsavory.
